fixture_state: historical held-out results disclosed; public regression audit only

public_artifact.kind: revised-Skill condition example from targeted regression

initial_ab.design: matched candidate task; Q=no-Skill baseline, R=target Skill; 15 fail-closed machine gates plus two-order blind judgment
initial_ab.source_commit_provenance: repository HEAD recorded in the contemporaneous work log; not embedded in the initial candidate freeze

resource_comparison.note: The target used fewer model terms, but model-term economy is not end-to-end authoring economy.

comparative_verdict.absolute_machine_validity: both candidates passed 15/15 and were supported inside the frozen synthetic benchmark
comparative_verdict.objective_comparison: Q no-Skill baseline was better on every reported predictive metric
comparative_verdict.subjective_comparison: Q no-Skill baseline won both candidate orders, 100 versus 70 mean

protocol_deviations.detail: Initial candidate paths used baseline and target names rather than neutral labels.
The target trace read UTF-8 Skill text without an explicit PowerShell 5 encoding, producing severe garbling and likely impairing semantic use.

The target primary model omitted raw gain and delay while claiming a threshold effect beyond additive main effects; its automatically augmented rival was therefore non-nested and the claim-to-model comparison was unfair.
The literal isolated evaluator command could not import its sibling helper. Both conditions used an explicit path workaround; the target also made one exploratory non-isolated Python invocation.
The retained candidate traces were second attempts; first-attempt traces were not retained.
Same model, decoding seed, CPU, memory and output caps were not established with forensic proof.
Prompt and runner controls were used, but no system-call-level proof of network and filesystem isolation was collected.
Blind judges were fresh contexts but from the same Codex model family, not independent humans or a different model family.

closed_loop_fix.trigger: Initial blind feedback located a UTF-8 portability failure and a claim-to-model hierarchy mismatch.
closed_loop_fix.snapshot_provenance: post-evaluation byte-identical public snapshot; not a contemporaneous runtime binding
changes: Added an explicit Windows PowerShell 5 UTF-8 portability instruction and mandatory reread on garbling.
Added a structural-hierarchy gate requiring matched lower-order main effects for incremental high-order mechanism claims.
closed_loop_fix.evidence_status: post-test correction; assessed only by a benchmark-informed targeted regression

targeted_regression.design: neutral Q/R paths; Q=no Skill, R=revised target Skill; new candidate generations and a separately committed held-out fixture
targeted_regression.independence_status: benchmark-informed targeted regression, not independent validation

discarded_forward_attempt.reason: first total disagreed with weighted dimension recomputation; fail-closed rerun

blind_judgment.decision_reason: Preferences were inconsistent across orders, so the frozen rule returns tie despite R's 98.0 versus Q's 95.5 mean.

supported: The initial Skill candidate and no-Skill baseline both produced runnable, traceable submissions that passed all 15 frozen machine gates in this synthetic benchmark.
The initial negative comparison identified actionable UTF-8 and model-hierarchy faults, and the revised Skill condition produced a properly nested five-term model in the targeted regression.
The revised example submission is structurally auditable and its recorded predictive metrics satisfy the frozen synthetic-task thresholds.
not_supported: A quality advantage for the Skill over a matched no-Skill condition.
End-to-end token or resource savings from using the Skill.
Causal or mechanistic proof, external validity, distributional generalization or production effectiveness.
An independent post-fix confirmation: the targeted regression was designed after inspecting the initial failure.
limitations: single synthetic task and single data generator
same Codex model family used for candidates and blind judges
held-out artifacts are disclosed after evaluation and are no longer hidden
initial A/B and targeted regression must not be pooled into a causal estimate

public_audit_scope: evaluate.py validates public JSON structure, submission hash, model nesting and cost, recorded gate counts, exact key metrics, token arithmetic, blind-score arithmetic and verdicts; it does not rerun an LLM, frozen model code or hidden data
